source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 7 exercise solved (PDF 162-166): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short and descriptive questions, numericals step by step, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Reaction Kinetics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah di gayi hai (kitab MCQs ki answer key nahi deti); short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur tamam numericals ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. The rate of reaction:
(Reaction ki raftar (rate):)

options.text: Reaction aage barhne ke saath barhti hai
Reaction aage barhne ke saath ghatti hai
Reaction ke dauran wahi rehti hai
Ghat bhi sakti hai aur barh bhi sakti hai

blocks.explanation: Reactants istemal hone se un ki concentration kam hoti hai, is liye fi second takkarein kam hoti hain; concentration-time graph waqt ke saath kam dhalwan ho jata hai (7.2).

blocks.prompt:
II. Increasing the temperature of a chemical reaction increases the rate of reaction because:
(Temperature barhane se reaction ki raftar kyun barhti hai?)

options.text: Reactant molecules ki takkaron ki tadaad aur takkaron ki energy dono barhti hain
Sirf takkaron ki tadaad barhti hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada temperature par molecules tez chalte hain: zyada baar aur zyada energy se takrate hain, is liye kahin zyada takkarein Ea se oopar hoti hain (7.3.2). Temperature Ea ko nahi badalta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Options (c) aur (d) mein 'increase' aur 'decrease' chhapa hai; durust 'increases' aur 'decreases' hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. Consider two reactions with different activation energies at the same temperature. The reaction with the lower activation energy will have:
(Aik hi temperature par mukhtalif activation energy wale do reactions: kam activation energy wale reaction ka:)

options.text: Rate constant enthalpy change par munhasir hoga

blocks.explanation: Energy ki rukawat kam ho to zyada takkarein kamyab hoti hain, reaction tez hota hai aur rate constant bara hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
IV. The order of a chemical reaction, that is independent of concentration is:
(Jis reaction ki raftar concentration se azad ho us ka order:)
blocks.explanation: Zero order reaction mein rate = k[A]⁰ = k; concentration badalne se raftar par koi asar nahi (7.4.3).

blocks.prompt:
V. On a Boltzmann distribution curve, the area under the curve represents:
(Boltzmann distribution curve ke neeche ka area kya zahir karta hai?)

options.text: Sample mein molecules ki kul tadaad.

blocks.explanation: Curve molecules ki tadaad ko energy ke muqable mein dikhata hai, is liye poora area kul particles ki tadaad hai (7.3.2).

blocks.prompt:
VI. On a Boltzmann distribution curve, the activation energy (Ea) is represented by:
(Boltzmann distribution curve par activation energy (Ea) kaise dikhai jati hai?)

options.text: Poore curve ke neeche ka area
Kisi khaas kinetic energy par khenchi gayi khari (vertical) lakeer

blocks.explanation: Ea energy axis par aik khaas qeemat hai jise khari lakeer se dikhate hain; us ke daayen taraf ka shaded area un molecules ki tadaad hai jin ki energy ≥ Ea (7.3.2).

blocks.prompt:
VII. If we double the concentration of a reactant, the rate increases by four times, the reaction is:
(Reactant ki concentration double karne se raftar chaar guna ho jaye to reaction:)
blocks.explanation: Rate = k[A]ⁿ: 2ⁿ = 4, is liye n = 2, second order.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. The rate determining step in a multi-step reaction is:
(Kai qadmon wale reaction mein rate determining step:)
blocks.explanation: Rate-determining step woh qadam hai jo baqi sab se kahin ahista ho; yahi poore reaction ki raftar ko mehdood karta hai (7.6).

blocks.prompt:
IX. The reaction NO₂ + CO → NO + CO₂ occurs in two steps. What is the rate law equation for this reaction?
2NO₂ → NO + NO₃ (k₁) slow
NO₃ + CO → CO₂ + NO₂ (k₂) fast
(NO₂ + CO → NO + CO₂ do qadmon mein hota hai. Is ka rate law kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ahista pehla qadam raftar tay karta hai, aur us mein do NO₂ molecules hain: R = k₁[NO₂]². CO ahista qadam ke baad aata hai, is liye rate law mein nahi (7.6).

blocks.prompt:
X. How does the presence of a catalyst affect the rate of a chemical reaction?
(Catalyst ki maujoodgi reaction ki raftar par kya asar daalti hai?)

options.text: Forward ki raftar barhata aur reverse ki kam karta hai.
Forward aur reverse dono ki raftar barhata hai.

blocks.explanation: Catalyst kam activation energy wala naya raasta deta hai jo forward aur reverse dono ki rukawat kam karta hai; equilibrium jaldi aata hai magar badalta nahi (7.3.3, 8.15).

blocks.prompt:
XI. On an energy profile diagram, the presence of a catalyst is represented by:
(Energy profile diagram par catalyst ki maujoodgi kaise dikhai jati hai?)

options.text: Activation energy ki oonchi choti se.
Activation energy ki neechi choti se.
Reactants ya products ki energy level badalne se.

blocks.explanation: Catalyst wale raaste ki rukawat (choti) neechi hoti hai; reactants aur products ki levels aur ΔH wahi rehte hain (7.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
XII. The units of the rate constant (k) for a reaction depend on the:
(Rate constant (k) ki units kis par munhasir hain?)
blocks.explanation: k = (mol dm⁻³)¹⁻ⁿ s⁻¹, jahan n kul order hai (7.4.4): first order ke liye s⁻¹, second order ke liye dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
XIII. A first-order reaction has a half-life (t1/2) of 20 minutes. What is the value of its rate constant (k)?
(Aik first-order reaction ki half-life 20 minute hai. Is ka rate constant (k) kya hai?)

blocks.text: Q.2 Neeche diye gaye mukhtasar sawalon ke jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. What do you understand by the rate of a reaction?
(Reaction ki raftar (rate) se aap kya samajhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction ki raftar kisi reactant ya product ki concentration ki tabdeeli ko us mein lagne wale waqt se taqseem karna hai: A → B ke liye rate = −Δ[A]/Δt = +Δ[B]/Δt. Is ki unit mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ hai (7.2).

blocks.prompt:
b. Give the difference between enthalpy change of reaction and energy of activation of reaction
(Reaction ke enthalpy change aur activation energy mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono energy profile diagram se parhe jate hain magar alag cheezein napte hain.

rows: Products aur reactants ki energy ka farq
Kamyab takkar ke liye molecules ko darkar kam az kam energy
Batata hai ke heat nikalti hai ya jazb hoti hai
Batata hai ke reaction kitna tez hai
Catalyst se kam ho jati hai

blocks.prompt:
c. Differentiate clearly between order and molecularity of a reaction.
(Reaction ke order aur molecularity mein wazeh farq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Order rate law ko bayan karta hai; molecularity aik elementary qadam ko.

rows: Rate equation mein concentrations ke exponents ka jor
Aik elementary qadam mein hissa lene wale molecules ki tadaad
Zero, poora adad ya fraction ho sakta hai
Hamesha poora adad (1, 2 ya 3), kabhi zero nahi

blocks.prompt:
d. Why the instantaneous rate changes during a reaction?
(Reaction ke dauran instantaneous rate kyun badalta rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction aage barhne se reactants khatam hote hain aur un ki concentration ghatti hai. Kam molecules, kam takkarein fi second, is liye har lamhe ki raftar (concentration-time curve ke tangent ki dhalwan) kam hoti jati hai (7.2, 7.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
e. Briefly summarize the effects of temperature and surface area on the rates of reactions.
(Temperature aur surface area ka reaction ki raftar par asar mukhtasaran bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Temperature: temperature barhne se molecules ki kinetic energy barhti hai, woh zyada takrate hain aur zyada molecules ki energy ≥ Ea hoti hai; har 10 °C par raftar taqreeban dugni ya tigni ho jati hai (7.3.2).
Surface area: solid reactant ke chhote tukre (powder) zyada satah kholte hain, is liye zyada particles aik waqt mein takra sakte hain aur raftar barhti hai (maslan pisa hua marble acid se dhelon ki nisbat tez react karta hai; misal chapter se bahar).

blocks.prompt:
f. Justify that the radioactive decay is always a first order reaction.
(Sabit karein ke radioactive decay hamesha first order reaction hota hai.)
blocks.explanation: Radioactive decay mein har ghair-mustahkam nucleus kisi se takraye baghair khud toot-ta hai, is liye raftar sirf maujood radioactive maadde ki miqdaar par munhasir hai: rate = k[A], yani first order. Is ki half-life constant hai, shuru ki miqdaar se azad, aur k = 0.693/t₁/₂; yahi first-order ki pehchan hai (chapter se bahar: decay par temperature, pressure ya catalyst ka asar nahi).

blocks.prompt:
g. A reaction is second order with respect to a reactant. How is the rate of reaction affected if the concentration is doubled and reduced to half?
(Aik reactant ke lehaz se reaction second order hai. Concentration double aur aadhi karne par raftar par kya asar hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Rate = k[A]².
Double: rate = k(2[A])² = 4k[A]², raftar chaar guna.
Aadhi: rate = k(½[A])² = ¼k[A]², raftar aik chauthai.

blocks.prompt:
h. What is meant by half-life and what is it used for?
(Half-life se kya murad hai aur yeh kis kaam aati hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Half-life, t₁/₂, woh waqt hai jis mein reactant ki concentration apni asal qeemat ki aadhi reh jaye.
Istemal: first-order reaction ka rate constant nikalna, k = 0.693/t₁/₂ (7.5.2); constant half-life batati hai ke reaction first order hai; yeh bhi batati hai ke radioactive maadda ya dawai kitni der asar rakhti hai (chapter se bahar).

blocks.prompt:
i. Why does wood burn more rapidly in pure oxygen than in air?
(Lakri khalis oxygen mein hawa ki nisbat tez kyun jalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa mein sirf taqreeban paanchwan hissa oxygen hai (chapter se bahar); baqi zyada tar nitrogen hai jo hissa nahi leti. Khalis oxygen mein O₂ molecules ki concentration kahin zyada hai, is liye woh lakri se zyada takrate hain aur jalne ki raftar barh jati hai (concentration ka asar, 7.3.1).

blocks.prompt:
j. A catalyst lowers the activation energy of a chemical reaction. Illustrate it.
(Catalyst reaction ki activation energy kam karta hai. Wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation: Catalyst kam rukawat wala naya raasta deta hai. Energy profile diagram (energy banam reaction ka raasta) mein dono raaste aik hi reactant level se shuru aur aik hi product level par khatam hote hain (ΔH wahi), magar catalyst wale curve ki choti neechi hai, is liye Ea(catalysed) < Ea(uncatalysed). Ab zyada molecules ki energy ≥ Ea hoti hai aur raftar barhti hai; maslan 2KClO₃ → 2KCl + 3O₂, MnO₂ ke saath kahin tez (7.3.3).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Diagram banane ka tareeqa: y-axis par energy, x-axis par reaction ka raasta. Baayen reactants ki level, daayen products ki level (exothermic mein neeche). Dono ko aik ooncha pahar (uncatalysed) aur aik neecha pahar (catalysed) se jorein; reactant level se har choti tak teer = Ea.

blocks.prompt:
k. The rate constant for a certain reaction is 3.5×10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ at 25 °C.
l. What is the order of the reaction.? Explain based on the units of the rate constant.
(25 °C par aik reaction ka rate constant 3.5×10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ hai. Reaction ka order kya hai? Rate constant ki units ki buniyad par wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
First order.
k ki units = (mol dm⁻³)¹⁻ⁿ s⁻¹. Yahan unit sirf s⁻¹ hai, concentration ka koi hissa nahi, is liye 1 − n = 0 aur n = 1 (7.4.4).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hissa k alag sawal ki tarah chhapa hai magar is mein sirf l, m aur n ke liye data hai; yeh teenon isi ke hisse hain. Hissa l ke aakhir mein faltu '.?' bhi chhapa hai.

blocks.prompt:
m. If the initial concentration of the reactant is 0.50 mol dm⁻³, calculate the initial rate of the reaction.
(Data from k: rate constant 3.5×10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ at 25 °C.)
(Agar reactant ki ibtidai concentration 0.50 mol dm⁻³ ho to ibtidai raftar maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
First order: rate = k[A]
rate = 3.5 × 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ × 0.50 mol dm⁻³
rate = 1.75 × 10⁻⁴ ≈ 1.8 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
n. How would the rate of this reaction change if the concentration of the reactant were doubled?
(Agar reactant ki concentration double kar di jaye to is reaction ki raftar kaise badlegi?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction first order hai (rate = k[A]), is liye concentration double karne se raftar bhi double: 1.75 × 10⁻⁴ se 3.5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (1.00 mol dm⁻³ par).

blocks.prompt:
o. A certain first-order reaction has a rate constant of 2.5×10⁻³ s⁻¹. Calculate the half-life of the reaction in minutes.
(Aik first-order reaction ka rate constant 2.5×10⁻³ s⁻¹ hai. Half-life minutes mein maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: k = 2.5 × 10⁻³ s⁻¹
Formula: t₁/₂ = 0.693 / k
t₁/₂ = 0.693 / 2.5 × 10⁻³ s⁻¹ = 277 s
Minutes mein: 277 s / 60 s min⁻¹ = 4.62 min

blocks.prompt:
p. A radioactive isotope decays by a first-order process with a half-life of 12 hours. Calculate the rate constant for the decay in s⁻¹.
(Aik radioactive isotope first-order process se toot-ta hai, half-life 12 ghante. Rate constant s⁻¹ mein maloom karein.)

Q.3 Relate the order of a reaction to the rate law for the reaction. How do you distinguish between zero order, first order and second order reaction?
(Reaction ke order ka rate law se taalluq bayan karein. Zero, first aur second order reactions mein farq kaise karenge?)
blocks.explanation:
Rate law: aA + bB → products ke liye rate = k[A]ˣ[B]ʸ, jahan x aur y tajurbe se maloom hote hain aur a, b ke barabar ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi; k rate constant hai.
Order: x, A ke lehaz se order, y, B ke lehaz se order, aur (x + y) kul order hai. Yani order seedha rate law ke exponents se parha jata hai, maslan rate = k[H₂][NO]²: H₂ mein first, NO mein second, kul third order. Yeh balanced equation se andaza nahi lagaya ja sakta.
Farq (table dekhein): concentration badalne par raftar ke rawaiye aur k ki units se.
Zero order: rate = k; misal: roshni wala H₂ + Cl₂ → 2HCl, 2NH₃ → N₂ + 3H₂.
First order: rate = k[A]; misal: 2N₂O₅ → 2N₂O₄ + O₂; is ki half-life constant hai, t₁/₂ = 0.693/k.
Second order: rate = k[A]² ya k[A][B]; misal: NO + O₃ → NO₂ + O₂.

rows: Raftar concentration ke murabba (square) ke mutanasib
k ki unit: mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹
k ki unit: dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 How do you find the numerical value of a rate constant by initial and half-life methods?
(Initial concentration method aur half-life method se rate constant ki qeemat kaise maloom karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
A. Initial concentration (ibtidai raftar) method:
1. Reactants ki mukhtalif ibtidai concentrations ke saath kai tajurbe karein, har baar sirf aik reactant badlein.
2. Har tajurbe mein ibtidai raftar napein, maslan H₂O₂ + 2I⁻ + 2H⁺ → 2H₂O + I₂ mein iodine banne ki ibtidai raftar.
3. Tajurbon ka muqabla kar ke har reactant ka order nikalein (maslan [H₂O₂] double karne se raftar double: first order), aur rate equation likhein: rate = k[H₂O₂][I⁻] (H⁺ mein zero order).
4. k ke liye equation ko tarteeb dein aur aik tajurbe ka data dalein: k = rate / ([H₂O₂][I⁻]) = 3.50 × 10⁻⁶ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ / (0.0200 × 0.0100 mol² dm⁻⁶) = 1.75 × 10⁻² dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ (7.5.1).
B. Half-life method:
1. Waqt ke saath reactant ki concentration napein aur half-life, t₁/₂, nikalein: concentration ke aadha hone ka waqt (constant half-life first order ki nishani hai).
2. First-order reaction ke liye k = 0.693 / t₁/₂.
3. t₁/₂ ko seconds mein badal kar dalein, maslan H₂O₂, t₁/₂ = 2 h = 7200 s: k = 0.693 / 7200 s = 9.6 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹ (7.5.2).

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 How does the activation energy profile of an uncatalyzed reaction compare with that of the catalyzed reaction?
(Baghair catalyst aur catalyst wale reaction ke activation energy profile ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Catalyst kam activation energy wala naya raasta deta hai (7.3.3). Energy profile (potential energy banam reaction ka raasta) mein dono curves aik hi reactant energy se shuru aur aik hi product energy par khatam hote hain, is liye ΔH wahi hai; catalyst wale curve ki choti neechi hai. Rukawat forward aur reverse dono ke liye kam hoti hai, is liye zyada molecules paar kar pate hain aur raftar barhti hai; equilibrium position nahi badalti.

rows: Kam molecules ki energy ≥ Ea; ahista
Zyada molecules ki energy ≥ Ea′; tez
Reactant aur product levels wahi, ΔH wahi
Reactant aur product levels wahi, ΔH wahi

blocks.prompt:
Q. 6 The reaction between hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) and iodide ions (I⁻) in acidic solution is believed to occur via the following mechanism:
Step 1: H₂O₂ + I⁻ ⟶ H₂O + OI⁻ (slow)
Step 2: OI⁻ + H⁺ ⟶ HOI (fast)
Step 3: HOI + I⁻ + H⁺ ⟶ H₂O + I₂ (fast)
i) Write the overall balanced equation for the reaction.
ii) Identify any intermediates and catalysts in this mechanism.
iii) What is the rate-determining step?
iv) Write the rate equation for the reaction, expressing it in terms of the reactants in the overall reaction.
(Tezabi mehlool mein H₂O₂ aur I⁻ ka reaction is mechanism se hota hai. i) Kul balanced equation, ii) intermediates aur catalysts, iii) rate-determining step, iv) rate equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
i) Teenon qadam jor kar OI⁻ aur HOI (bante aur phir khatam ho jate hain) cancel karein:
H₂O₂ + 2I⁻ + 2H⁺ → 2H₂O + I₂
ii) Intermediates: OI⁻ (qadam 1 mein bana, qadam 2 mein khatam) aur HOI (qadam 2 mein bana, qadam 3 mein khatam). Catalyst: koi nahi; H⁺ istemal ho jata hai (kul equation mein reactant hai), aur koi cheez istemal ho kar wapas waisi nahi milti.
iii) Qadam 1, ahista qadam: H₂O₂ + I⁻ → H₂O + OI⁻.
iv) Raftar ahista qadam tay karta hai jis ke reactants H₂O₂ aur I⁻ hain: rate = k[H₂O₂][I⁻]. H₂O₂ mein first order, I⁻ mein first order, H⁺ mein zero order (yeh ahista qadam ke baad aata hai), kul second order; yeh tajurbe wale rate equation se milta hai (7.5.1, 7.6).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Intermediate aur catalyst ki pehchan: intermediate pehle banta hai phir khatam hota hai (kul equation mein nahi aata); catalyst pehle istemal hota hai phir wapas ban jata hai (yeh bhi kul equation mein nahi aata). Rate equation sirf ahista qadam ke reactants se banti hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q.6 Calculate the reaction rate if the concentration of A is 0.5 M, the concentration of B is 0.2 and the rate constant k is 4.0 M⁻² s⁻¹. Given the rate law for a reaction: Rate = k[A][B]².
(Agar [A] = 0.5 M, [B] = 0.2 (M) aur k = 4.0 M⁻² s⁻¹ ho, aur rate law Rate = k[A][B]² ho, to reaction ki raftar maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: [A] = 0.5 M, [B] = 0.2 M, k = 4.0 M⁻² s⁻¹
Formula: Rate = k[A][B]²
Qeematein: Rate = 4.0 M⁻² s⁻¹ × 0.5 M × (0.2 M)²
Rate = 4.0 × 0.5 × 0.04 M s⁻¹
Rate = 0.08 M s⁻¹ (= 8 × 10⁻² mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Numerical problems ki numbering dobara Q.6 se shuru hoti hai, jo aakhri descriptive sawal ka number bhi hai. B ki concentration '0.2' baghair unit chhapi hai; yeh 0.2 M hai (k ki unit M⁻² s⁻¹ hai).

blocks.prompt:
Q.7 A first order reaction is found to have a rate constant, k = 5.5 × 10⁻¹⁴ s⁻¹. Find the half-life of the reaction.
(Aik first order reaction ka rate constant k = 5.5 × 10⁻¹⁴ s⁻¹ hai. Is ki half-life maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: k = 5.5 × 10⁻¹⁴ s⁻¹
Formula: t₁/₂ = 0.693 / k
Qeematein: t₁/₂ = 0.693 / 5.5 × 10⁻¹⁴ s⁻¹
t₁/₂ = 1.26 × 10¹³ s
(taqreeban 4.0 × 10⁵ saal, 1 saal = 3.15 × 10⁷ s lene par)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Q.8 se oopar page par 500 se 700 K tak rate constants ka aik table chhapa hai (6.814 × 10⁻⁴ se 66.67 × 10⁰ cm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹) jis ke saath koi sawal nahi; yeh Q.8 ka hissa nahi.

blocks.prompt:
Q.8 Three experiments that have identical conditions were performed to measure the initial rate of the reaction. 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g)
(Table printed: experiment 1, [HI] = 0.015 M, rate = 1.1×10⁻³ M/s; experiment 2, 0.030 M, 4.4×10⁻³ M/s; experiment 3, 0.045 M, 9.9×10⁻³ M/s.)
Write the rate law for the reaction. Find the value and units of the specific rate constant, k.
(2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g) ki ibtidai raftar teen tajurbon mein napi gayi (table). Rate law likhein aur specific rate constant k ki qeemat aur unit maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Farz karein rate = k[HI]ⁿ.
Tajurba 1 aur 2: [HI] double (0.015 → 0.030 M) aur raftar 4.4 × 10⁻³ / 1.1 × 10⁻³ = 4 guna. 2ⁿ = 4, is liye n = 2.
Tajurba 3 se check: [HI] teen guna, raftar 9.9 × 10⁻³ / 1.1 × 10⁻³ = 9 = 3² guna.
Rate law: Rate = k[HI]² (second order)
k = Rate / [HI]²
Tajurba 1 se: k = 1.1 × 10⁻³ M s⁻¹ / (0.015 M)²
k = 1.1 × 10⁻³ M s⁻¹ / 2.25 × 10⁻⁴ M²
k = 4.9 M⁻¹ s⁻¹ (= 4.9 dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹); tajurba 2 aur 3 se bhi yahi qeemat aati hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Order nikalne ka tareeqa: jis tajurbe mein concentration double ho, dekhein raftar kitni guna hui: 1 guna = zero order, 2 guna = first order, 4 guna = second order. k ki unit (mol dm⁻³)¹⁻ⁿ s⁻¹ se: n = 2 par M⁻¹ s⁻¹.

items: MCQs ke jawab: I b, II a, III b, IV c, V b, VI c, VII a, VIII c, IX d, X d, XI b, XII c, XIII c.

Kitab ki ghaltiyan: MCQ II ke (c), (d) mein 'increase/decrease'; short k asal mein l, m, n ka data hai aur l ke aakhir mein '.?'; numericals ki numbering dobara Q.6 se aur B ki concentration baghair unit; Q.8 se oopar baghair sawal ke aik table.
Numericals: m 1.8 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; o 4.62 min; p 1.60 × 10⁻⁵ s⁻¹; Q.6 0.08 M s⁻¹; Q.7 1.26 × 10¹³ s; Q.8 Rate = k[HI]², k = 4.9 M⁻¹ s⁻¹.
